clips.title: The story
paras: At Dun Modr, Balgaras the Foul's ear marks the warlock's end. Recovered from the Dark Iron commander's corpse, it gives Ironforge's mountaineers proof of his death.

Balgaras the Foul commanded the Dark Iron assault on Dun Modr. The invaders sabotaged the Thandol Span and destroyed the local dwarven garrison, leaving the outpost in ruins. A scheming warlock, Balgaras directed his troops from the shadows and shunned personal combat. Longbraid the Grim, the mountain king's officer stationed outside the ruins, wants proof that the ringleader has fallen. Balgaras's severed ear confirms the warlock's reign at the northern border is over.

Dun Modr's fall cost Longbraid his brother and dozens of stout soldiers in the collapse of the West Bridge. The ear cannot mend the span or revive the fallen. With Balgaras unable to direct them, the surviving Dark Iron forces scattered through the northern Wetlands become easier for Ironforge's scouts to contain before another commander arrives from the south.
